t.zh: 第三步要造一句说「我证不出」的话。难处在于一句话写不进自己的编码：编码比句子长。哥德尔的办法是<wiki-ref to="diagonal"></wiki-ref>：先写一句带空位 □ 的话 D：「对角 □ 证不出」。取对角是一次计算：把一句带空位的话自己的编码 ⌜…⌝ 填进它的空位。
t.en: The third step makes a sentence that says “I cannot be proved”. The trouble is that a sentence cannot hold its own code: the code is longer than the sentence. Gödel’s way is the <wiki-ref to="diagonal"></wiki-ref>: first write a sentence D with a gap □, “the diagonal of □ cannot be proved”. Taking the diagonal is a computation: put a sentence’s own code ⌜…⌝ into its gap.

t.zh: G 是 D 的对角。第一个目标算出 G；第二个目标算出 G 说到的那句话（对角 ⌜D⌝ 的值）。
t.en: G is the diagonal of D. The first goal works out G; the second works out the sentence G speaks of (the value of the diagonal of ⌜D⌝).

after.zh: 这就是对角线引理：对任何说法 P(□)，都有一句 G 和 P(⌜G⌝) 等价。
after.en: This is the diagonal lemma: for any property P(□) there is a sentence G equivalent to P(⌜G⌝).

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
